patch_description: This crossover combines the current program’s diverse, novelty-aware archive and multi-move neighborhoods with the inspiration program’s operator portfolio. LP proposals are drawn from bottleneck-focused switches, random switches, three-link rotations, random-walk kicks, and consensus-guided switches; operator outcomes adjust their future share of the evaluation batch. Surrogate energy and LP dual prices rank proposals before spending LP calls, while a novelty slot and diverse seeding help retain exploration. The unchanged wrapper is included so the file remains runnable.
